rationale: What the curated public GitHub mirror carries (mirror: curated, #1631/#1594). GitLab stays the full private repo; scripts/github-export.mjs builds one snapshot commit holding only paths under 'include', minus every 'exclude' path, and check-owner-leakage.mjs --public-export fails if any other tracked path survives. Each path is an exact file or a directory prefix ending in '/'; no globs. A new top-level path stays private until it is added to 'include'. Version 2 marks the allow-list: an exporter that knows only version 1 (deny-only) refuses this file instead of ignoring 'include'.
